data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
(None — infrastructure task; DD ownership is in task-2, which depends on this AcliClient capability extension.)

Extend `plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py` with the symmetric read counterparts to the existing `set_issue_property`/`_direct_rest_put` pair.

Changes:
- Add `_direct_rest_get(self, path: str) -> dict` — mirrors `_direct_rest_put` (lines ~718-735): builds a `urllib.request.Request` against `f"{self.jira_url.rstrip('/')}{path}"` with method `GET`, the existing `Authorization: Basic {self._creds}` header, no body, 10s timeout. Parses `resp.read()` as JSON and returns the resulting dict.
- Add `get_issue_property(self, jira_key: str, property_key: str) -> Any` — mirrors `set_issue_property`. Builds path `/rest/api/3/issue/{jira_key}/properties/{property_key}`, calls `_direct_rest_get(path)`, returns `response['value']`.

Add new tests to `tests/scripts/test_acli_integration_set_issue_property.py` (UPDATE — tests must fail before implementation). Add `test_get_issue_property_returns_value` and `test_direct_rest_get_uses_basic_auth_and_timeout`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && bash -c "$TEST_CMD"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] AcliClient.get_issue_property invokes _direct_rest_get against /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/properties/{property_key} and returns the parsed 'value' field
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_acli_integration_set_issue_property.py::test_get_issue_property_returns_value -xvs
- [ ] AcliClient._direct_rest_get issues a GET with Authorization Basic header and 10s timeout
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_acli_integration_set_issue_property.py::test_direct_rest_get_uses_basic_auth_and_timeout -xvs
- [ ] Existing set_issue_property tests continue to pass (no regression)
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_acli_integration_set_issue_property.py -xvs

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
